sources: https://d29dxerjsp82wz.cloudfront.net/api/v3/event/live/1332.json + /api/v3/fight/live/<fmid>.json (UFC.com official FightMetric stats feed behind https://www.ufc.com/event/ufc-fight-night-october-17-2026; OfficialStats=true, Status=Final on all 13 bouts; per-bout URLs listed in each bout; raw files in /workspace/edmonton/ufcjson/ and /workspace/edmonton/ev1332.json)
https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/UFC_Fight_Night:_Buckley_vs._Malott (cross-check of winner, method, round, time, judges' scores)
http://ufcstats.com (primary source, but unreachable from the box on 2026-10-18: TCP connect timeouts; not used)
/workspace/edmonton/backup/upcoming_card.json = upcoming_card.json as of 2026-10-11 (bout list, weight classes, name spellings)
notes: UFCStats.com could not be reached from the box on 2026-10-18 (TCP timeouts). Stats were taken from the official UFC.com FightMetric feed (OfficialStats=true on all 13 bouts). Same approach as the 2026-10-11 Vegas 122 file. ufcstats_url is null; ufcstats_name holds the UFC.com spelling. Nothing is estimated.
Fighter order in each bout is red corner then blue corner (UFCStats order). judges_scores are fighters[0]-fighters[1] per judge; Wikipedia winner-perspective scores are in wikipedia_result.

Weight class/name fields use upcoming_card.json spelling (e.g. Cristian Perez Gonzalez, Timothy Cuamba, You Su-young, Marc-André Barriault); ufcstats_name is the UFC.com spelling (Cristian Perez, Timmy Cuamba, SuYoung You, Marc-Andre Barriault).

Method-detail wording diffs (winner/round/time match Wikipedia on all 13): Malott finish UFC.com "Knee to Head At Distance" vs Wikipedia "KO (knee and punch)"; Nallo finish UFC.com "Punches to Head On Ground" vs Wikipedia "TKO (leg kick and punches)"; Galanti finish UFC.com "Neck Crank From Back Control" vs Wikipedia "Submission (face crank)".
Season 5 drafted_team on this card: Erin Blanchfield → Ninos (L); Jasmine Jasudavicius → Mary (W)
Raw data saved in /workspace/edmonton/ufcjson/ (fight JSON) and /workspace/edmonton/ev1332.json; build script /workspace/edmonton/build.py.
Fantasy points are NOT computed here; the app does that.
